name: baton
description: Local agent client with native delegation and observability: drives the agent CLIs you already have (Claude Code, Codex, pi, any ACP agent).

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/protocol packages/providers packages/server && npm run build -w @baton/web --if-present
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/protocol packages/providers packages/server && npm run typecheck -w @baton/web --if-present
